decks.notes: This deck aims to utilize the Underworld Breach combo to generate infinite mana and cast spells from the graveyard. It includes powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Timetwister to draw through the deck quickly, along with key combo pieces like Bolas's Citadel and Hullbreacher. With efficient mana sources like Moxen and Tolarian Academy, the deck can quickly assemble the combo and win the game through Brain Freeze or other win conditions. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Pyroblast to protect the combo.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through the use of cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation, while also utilizing Oath of Druids to cheat powerful creatures onto the battlefield. Using cards like Show and Tell and Flash, the deck can quickly bring out threats like Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes powerful card draw and tutor effects like Ancestral Recall, Brainstorm, and Demonic Tutor to help find key pieces and maintain card advantage. Overall, the strategy revolves around controlling the game and quickly establishing a strong board presence.

The main focus of this Vintage 1 vs 1 deck is to quickly and aggressively utilize cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to fill up the graveyard with creatures such as Hollow One, Master of Death, and Vengevine. This allows for explosive early-game plays and consistent pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap to protect its key creatures and spells, making it a formidable aggro deck capable of overwhelming opponents with a fast and relentless attack strategy.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy by utilizing a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and card advantage. By constantly disrupting the opponent's plays and controlling the board state, the player aims to gain incremental advantages over time and eventually overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and threats. Lurrus of the Dream-Den serves as a versatile companion that can be used to recur key spells and permanents, while the rest of the deck consists of a mix of efficient removal spells, card draw spells, and disruptive creatures to control the game.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while generating incremental advantage with powerful threats. By utilizing disruptive cards like Force of Will, Collector Ouphe, and Wasteland, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up aggressive plays with cards like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Leovold, Emissary of Trest. The deck also has access to efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Abrupt Decay to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to control the game's tempo and pressure the opponent with its versatile threats.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through the use of counterspells and removal while utilizing the powerful Oath of Druids card to cheat out big creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes key cards like Show and Tell and flash to quickly bring out game-changing threats. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's plans while setting up its own win condition through the use of powerful creatures and spells. The inclusion of cards like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor also helps to find key pieces needed to secure victory.

This deck revolves around utilizing the Underworld Breach card to generate a powerful combo that allows for quick and efficient win conditions. The deck includes a variety of powerful draw spells, fast mana sources, and disruption cards to enable the combo to go off smoothly. By utilizing cards like Wheel of Fortune, Tinker, and Timetwister, the deck aims to quickly set up a winning board state and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond. The inclusion of powerful counterspells like Force of Will and disruption cards like Hullbreacher ensures that the combo can be protected and executed effectively.

The deck focuses on assembling a quick and powerful combo using cards like Underworld Breach, Tinker, and Bolas's Citadel. By utilizing fast mana sources like Black Lotus and Moxen, along with tutors like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor, the deck aims to quickly draw through the deck using Ancestral Recall, Brainstorm, and Ponder to find the necessary combo pieces. Control elements like Force of Will and Pyroblast help protect the combo, while disruption like Hullbreacher and Fatal Push can disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck aims to win the game with an explosive Brain Freeze or combos involving Bolas's Citadel and Underworld Breach.

This deck focuses on utilizing Paradoxical Outcome as a key card to generate card advantage and mana with artifact spells, allowing the player to chain together powerful plays and combo off quickly. The deck includes various powerful restricted cards like Time Walk, Ancestral Recall, and Black Lotus to maximize its potential. Additionally, the inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional utility and recursion for the deck, making it a versatile and potent combo deck in Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

It also utilizes Show and Tell to put threats into play quickly. The deck includes a variety of strong counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect its game plan. Additionally, the deck features powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Demonic Tutor, and Tinker to find key pieces. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Oko, Thief of Crowns adds versatility and disruption to the control strategy.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, while also utilizing removal like Fatal Push and creatures like Psychic Frog to control the board. The deck is also able to draw cards and search for key pieces with cards like Ancestral Recall, Dig Through Time, and Demonic Tutor. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Lurrus of the Dream-Den and Mishra's Bauble to generate card advantage and maintain a steady stream of threats and answers.

This Doomsday combo deck focuses on quickly drawing through the deck to set up a win condition with Thassa's Oracle or Laboratory Maniac. Key cards like Doomsday, Demonic Tutor, and Necropotence allow for efficient digging and setting up the perfect pile to win the game. Powerful disruption tools like Force of Will and Flusterstorm help protect the combo, while cantrips and draw spells like Ponder and Preordain ensure consistent card selection and manipulation. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game before the opponent can respond effectively.

The deck focuses on utilizing card draw and mana acceleration to quickly generate a large amount of mana and draw cards. It seeks to assemble the combo of Paradoxical Outcome with artifact mana sources and card draw spells to generate a large amount of mana and draw through the deck. The deck includes powerful artifacts like Mana Vault, Black Lotus, and Moxen, with key pieces like Tinker, Time Vault, and Karn, the Great Creator to help set up the combo. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will to protect the combo.

Leovold, Emissary of Trest provides card advantage and disruption, while Oko, Thief of Crowns can deal with opposing threats. The deck also includes powerful spells like Force of Will and Ancestral Recall to control the game. By combining disruptive elements with powerful threats, this deck aims to outmaneuver the opponent and secure victory through a combination of tempo advantage and card advantage.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with Dredge cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Grave-Troll, allowing for explosive plays with cards like Prized Amalgam and Narcomoeba. Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder help to set up the graveyard efficiently, while cards like Creeping Chill provide additional value. The deck also runs disruptive cards like Grief and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and consistent graveyard-based combo.
